Inner Cycle Execution within Outer Cycle

BTS shall repeat the execution of Steps 14 to 17 exactly 3 times as defined by CYC 3* at Step 17.
Each time the inner cycle completes execution, BTS shall return to Step 14 until the count reaches 3.
After completing 3 iterations of the inner cycle, BTS shall proceed to Step 18.
